routes.directions: From Agora go south through the Ravine; climb the path beside the temple and inspect fruit trees along the mountain path.
Break fruit baskets by houses and benches; Apple is a possible result.
Enter Pooh’s book beside Merlin at the Bistrot, then use the sign behind Rabbit’s house to play for possible Apple rewards.
Go south from Agora through the Ravine, climb beside the temple and inspect the fruit trees up to Mountainside.
Break fruit baskets beside houses, benches and street corners for possible Apricots.
Check fruit crates near the Docks produce stalls, then go south to crates at the far end of the Seaport pier.
Jump outside from the bedroom; check herbs in the lawn and flowerbeds.
Check the southwestern Hills; from Wildflower Clearing go west to the northern Wetlands; check bushes before the bridge from Shore to the Kingdom. Herbs may be absent on a visit.
Inspect herbs behind the rock under the palm trees in front of the cave.
From Agora enter the building behind the serpent fountain and inspect herbs along the grassy alley.
Jump from the bedroom window and inspect the lawn and flowerbeds.
From Marsh go south and check the western Hills route. From Thoroughfare cross back over the bridge, turn toward the beach and check nearby bushes.
Use the Leviathan sea chart to reach the western island; inspect the herb beside the central rock.
From Agora climb the northwest stairs, turn right and inspect mushrooms in the grassy opening on the right.
From Marsh return toward Hills and inspect mushrooms beside a rock in the connecting passage.
Enter the western passage near the save point and inspect mushrooms around the rocks; the node may be absent.
Sail to the western island and inspect mushrooms on tree bark at its northwestern side.
Leave the Old Mansion and turn right in the clearing to inspect the western mushroom patch.
Inspect the right-hand mushroom on the fallen tree in the middle of the area.
From the save point enter the eastern cave and inspect mushrooms on the rocks.
Break lunchboxes on benches, street corners and rooftops for possible Butter.
From Main Floor 1F step outside the entrance and turn right to the lunchbox on cardboard boxes; also check the couch beside the Rest Area save point.
In South District climb the eastern stairs to the bench overlooking the highway. In North District inspect the lunchbox on a western building’s roof.
From Treescape check yellow crates along the eastern edge, then the southeastern Valley of Ice; also search yellow crates in Snowfield and Foothills.
Break the crate beside the woman ahead of the Settlement save point, the cart north beside the house, and the cart at the northern Docks.
Use the sign beside Tigger near the save point; Carrots are a possible minigame reward.
Check lunchboxes on the northeastern rooftop, central elevated platform and theater.
Check the lunchbox behind the southeastern 1F counters, then ride to 2F and check the eastern display counter.
Break vegetable baskets in northeastern Agora, beside the eastern Big Olive vendor, and along the northern wall below the Overlook stairs.
Strike the vending machine east of the save point for a possible Celery result.
Break the vegetable cart at the western pier end; check carts beside houses left of the Settlement save point and at the southern end of town.
Enter behind Agora’s serpent fountain, cross the grass and turn right; inspect the grassy nook beside the building under construction.
Leave the Old Mansion gates, follow the eastern edge of the clearing to its southeastern mushroom patch.
Check fallen bark at the southern Hills, halfway along the southern Marsh edge, and bushes east of the bridge on Shore. Nodes may be absent.
Check mushrooms on rocks beneath the palms outside the eastern cave.
Check lunchboxes behind the eastern 1F counter, northern counter of Babies & Toddlers: Dolls on 3F, and the counter beside the Kid Korral entrance.
Take the lift to 2F, pass the yellow stairs and turn left along the corridor; drop from the control-panel end into the hidden Ground Floor room.
In South District follow the eastern edge north, climb stairs and turn left to bench lunchboxes. In North District check the bench northwest of the save point.
Check lunchboxes beside the southwestern save point and on and below the northeastern house’s roof.
From Rest Area go southeast to the display-counter lunchbox; also check behind the eastern counter in Action Plus.
Turn left from the save point and descend to the docks; inspect bubbles beside the pier and farther north near the western end.
Head toward Snowfield and break the yellow crate beside the barrels at the Satyr encounter.
Swim to fish shoals around the islands and examine them for possible Cod.
Check the lunchbox on barrels in the northeastern outdoor theater corner.
Check the lunchbox on cardboard boxes right outside the main entrance, the Rest Area couch and behind the Action Plus counters.

routes.area: Huddled Isles / Isla de los Mástiles
routes.directions: Examine dormant lobsters in the water behind the Huddled Isles save point and near the ship at Isla de los Mástiles.

routes.area: Isle of Luck / Horseshoe Island / Sandbar Isle
routes.directions: Sail to each island and inspect submerged lobster nodes; circle Isle of Luck’s outer rim. Nodes may be absent on a visit.
Strike machines outside Laugh Floor; from Basement enter the white door, pass the first machines and check the southwestern pair.

routes.area: Forsaken Isle / Isla de los Mástiles / Confinement Isle
routes.directions: Check herbs behind Forsaken’s save point; climb central Mástiles and go to the southeast end; sail to Confinement and inspect its northeastern shore.
Break the lunchbox in the central back alley near the tram tracks.

Inspect Tower’s stream, the southwestern Hills pond and pond northeast of its save point, the hidden swamp southeast of Marsh, and the Shore lake across the Thoroughfare bridge. Bubble nodes may be absent.
Inspect the last stall on the left ahead of the save point and the right-hand stall in the open area near the castle.
Check the bench beneath the second southern building, the western roof before Central District, and the northwestern back alley and closed shop.
Play using Tigger’s sign near the save point for possible Eggplant rewards.
Successful cooking can award Filet Mignon as a bonus; it is not guaranteed for each dish.
From Lobby & Offices go east, then check the lunchbox behind the last left-hand desk at the northern end.
At the pier end turn left and go south to the street’s yellow crate. At Fort climb the archway wall behind the save point to the rooftop crate.
Check the Rest Area couch and the counter lunchbox in Babies & Toddlers: Dolls on 3F.
Check the last left-hand stall north of the save point, then the left-hand stall nearer the castle.
Check the western roof before Central District, the box under the eastern elevated walkway, and boxes by the northwestern closed shop and end of its back alley.
Use Tigger’s sign near the save point for possible Garlic rewards.
Inspect the grassy alley behind Agora’s serpent fountain and the slope northwest of the Gardens save point.
Check mushroom patches in the central area and along its northern edge.
Check the southeastern edge, then wall-run up the cliff a little west to inspect the ledge mushrooms.
Check baskets at the northeastern Agora vendor, eastern Big Olive vendor and northern wall below Overlook’s stairs.
Check the bench north of the save point and fruit basket in the northeastern theater.
Strike the vending machine near Laugh Floor’s entrance; from Basement take the white door and check southwestern Lower Level machines.
Check the fruit crate near the save point and the crate behind the western house.
Use Lumpy’s sign behind Rabbit’s house for possible Lemon rewards.
Descend left from Thoroughfare to the docks and inspect bubbles in the southern water; cross the bridge back to Shore and check its lake.

routes.area: Huddled Isles / Isla Verdemontaña / Sandbar Isle
routes.directions: Inspect brown lobster nodes in the water behind Huddled’s save point, Verdemontaña’s southeastern and northwestern waters, and southern Sandbar.
Reach these islands by ship and inspect underwater lobster nodes.
Go northwest from the save point and inspect mushrooms just before the slope; the node may be absent.
Inspect fallen bark along the western Hills edge and mushrooms northeast of the Marsh save point.
Follow the path from the save point and inspect mushrooms under trees on the left at the first opening.
Cross the forest southward; check its southern edge and the route from the nearby fork toward the cliff drop.
Descend left from Thoroughfare; inspect bubbles beside the second pier and between the second and third piers near boats.
Go east through the brick passage and open area, enter the next corridor and climb the stairs to the workbench lunchbox.

routes.area: Huddled Isles / Sandbar Isle / Isla Verdemontaña
routes.directions: Inspect underwater shell clusters behind Huddled’s save point; at Sandbar climb the southern rocks and dive into the circular pond and caves; check Verdemontaña’s surrounding waters.

routes.area: Isle of Luck / Horseshoe Island / Ship’s End
routes.directions: Sail to these islands and inspect submerged shell clusters.
Enter Babies & Toddlers: Dolls through the window and check northeastern cupboards; also check the counter beside Kid Korral’s entrance.
From Basement enter the white door and strike the first machine on the left; also check the machine beside Accessway’s save point.
Check benches at the middle and western parts of South District’s eastern walkway; in northwestern North District check the first rooftop and below the overpass.
Break baskets at northeastern Agora’s vendor, eastern Big Olive’s stall, inside the building northeast of Gardens, and below Overlook’s northern wall.
From Accessway go west into the Factory and check the lunch table at the southern end.
Check the cart left of the save point, crate below a southern house and cart on the eastern path toward the bridge.
Check the vegetable box on a bench beside the second building north of the save point.
From Summit return toward Cliff Ascent and check the fruit basket in the torch-lit corner on the right.
Check baskets southwest of the save point, beside a central door and on an eastern bench.
From Basement enter the right-hand door and strike the right machine of the pair to the left; also check Tank Yard’s eastern machine.
Check the fruit crate in front of the produce stall by the house south of the save point.
Play at the sign behind Rabbit’s house for possible Pear rewards.
Inspect mushrooms in the alley behind Agora’s serpent fountain and at the southern end of Gardens.
Leave Old Mansion’s gates and climb the leaning tree in the central clearing to mushrooms near its top.
Sail to the island and inspect mushrooms under rocks near its southern beach.
Check the couch east of Action Plus’s entrance and the northeastern 3F couch between Game Store and Babies & Toddlers: Dolls.
Check the stalls nearest the save point on both sides of the street.
Check the second cart left of the save point, the crate by a southern house and the small cart farther east on that street.
Use Tigger’s sign for possible Pumpkin rewards.
Check the yellow crate inside the building by the pier entrance west of Docks, then the crate beside the house right of Settlement’s save point.
Check the central bench on South District’s eastern walkway, beneath Central District’s circular-cluster building, and the bench around the northwestern bend from North District’s save point.
From Lobby & Offices go northeast and check the lunchbox on the right-hand counter at Laugh Floor’s entrance.
Check atop the chef statue’s hat, the far bench of South District’s elevated walkway, beneath Central District’s circular-cluster building, and barrels under the northwestern North District overpass.
Go northwest and inspect herbs left of the slope toward the ruined building.
Inspect southeastern flowerbeds and herbs along the eastern and western yard edges.
From Tower’s cave turn left into Hills and check beneath the central tree and the tree northwest. From Campsite go west to the northeastern Wetlands cliff.
Cross the forest to the southern side and inspect herbs on a rock.
Strike the left vending machine at Laugh Floor’s entrance and the eastern Tank Yard machines.
Climb Sandbar’s southern rocks and inspect herbs by the cliff drop; sail to Isle of Luck and check a ledge on the small northern rock.
Cross back over Thoroughfare’s bridge and turn right to shoreline shells; descend to Wharf and inspect bubbles at the lake’s eastern edge.

routes.area: Huddled Isles / Isla de los Mástiles / Sandbar Isle
routes.directions: Check shells in southeastern Huddled waters, western and central Mástiles waters near the ship, and rocks underwater south of Sandbar.
Reach these islands by ship and inspect underwater shell nodes.
Descend left from Thoroughfare to Wharf and inspect western bubbles; across the bridge on Shore check the lake’s northwestern edge.
Swim up to fish schools around islands and examine them for possible Sea Bass.
Climb the giant chef statue near the save point and break the lunchbox atop its hat.
Check the back-alley lunchbox near the tram’s brick archway and the lunchbox on a bench in the northeastern theater.
Descend the stairs left of Thoroughfare’s entrance and inspect bubbles between the first and second piers.
Check herbs beneath bushes on the western lawn and at the southwestern yard end.
Check east of the Hills save point; from Marsh go south into Hills and check the beginning of the clearing.
Sail to the islands; inspect southeastern Horseshoe herbs and herbs near the Ship’s End landing area.
Check the couch near Action Plus’s entrance and the lunchbox at 3F’s northeastern corner.
From Basement enter the white door and strike the right machine of the southwestern pair.
Check the third stall on the left north of the save point and first right-hand stall in the castle square.
Check the crate beside the shopper south of the save point and the cart on the eastern route toward the bridge.
Check the central bench of the eastern elevated walkway, the alley between western North District buildings, and the northwestern roof.
From Agora’s northeastern stairs turn right, cross the rubble and check the yellow crate among brown crates in the right corner. Also search yellow crates up the Cliff Ascent path.
Check the lunchbox on a bench in the northeastern theater.
Go south from Docks and break the yellow crate beside a treasure chest at the lower end of the large pier.
Check the second stall left of the save point and crates on the left of the larger square ahead.
Check the middle bench and underside of South District’s eastern walkway, the last northwestern North District roof, and the western street below.
Use Tigger’s sign for possible Zucchini rewards.
